one_line: Open on a satisfying product visual, give quick tips in home footage, then reveal the product and a comment-for-link ask.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close-up: paint poured from a cup over a white figure, streaking down. Subtitled from the first frame and said (transcript): "חושפת לכם את הסוד", then "...שלי ליצירת חוויות עם הילדים על פני זמן מסך". Her face appears at 0:03.
q1_hook.why: Motion and a striking product visual from frame one (H1, E1), with a headline and a voice that open together (T3, H6). "My secret" for time with the kids beyond screens opens a gap that closes when the kit is named at 0:29 (H5). The face and the book-like product are not there yet (H4).

beats.what: Close-up paint pour over a white figure; the "secret" line
beats.why: A satisfying visual plus a promise

beats.what: She holds a stack of kit boxes, eyebrows raised at the lens
beats.why: A face and the product line appear

beats.what: Top-down hands cut and tape paper, write "זמן של יחד"
She lays foil trays and boxes on the floor
beats.why: Tips 2 and 3: remove temptations, explain beforehand

beats.what: A girl about 8 pulls on gloves, a boy about 4 holds a figure
beats.why: Real children bring warmth to the tip

beats.what: Hands mix paint in a cup; "בחרתי הפעם את פור פאלז"
Stirring and pouring in close-up, then the family on the floor
beats.why: Shows the method and that each piece differs

beats.what: Duck pour; kit contents said; "רק ליהנות ולצבור זיכרונות ביחד"
Hello Kitty pour; where to buy said in the voice
Finished figures in foil trays outdoors; the comment ask
beats.why: Ends on the results with the ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Spoken and subtitled at 0:54: comment on the video for a link and coupon. Caption repeats it ("תגיבו לסרטון והבוטית תקפיץ לכם") or says to save the video. No question.
q2_flow.why: The "secret" holds the viewer to 0:29 and about 38 cuts keep something new on screen every 1 to 2 s (R3, E2). Tips sit inside family footage (K4). The 0:05 to 0:25 stretch has little product in action (R3). The finished figures close it (R4).

q3_cta.what: Spoken and subtitled 0:54 to 0:56: "אז אשלח לכם קישור לרכישה וקופון אם תגיבו לסרטון". Caption: comment for the link ("והבוטית תקפיץ לכם") or save the video and look in a nearby toy store. No comment word.
q3_cta.why: Said and shown after the value, with something real to get (link and coupon), and repeated in the caption (C6, C2, C3). The caption adds a second action, save and visit a store (C1). The subtitle sits in the bottom band (C6, T4).

q4_shown.what: Paint pouring over figures from 0:00; boxes held at 0:03; setup on paper and trays; a girl about 8 and a boy about 4 with two adults mixing and pouring; finished figures at 0:55. Kit contents and stores are said, not shown. No price.
q4_shown.why: A real family using the kit in a real home is first-hand proof (S6, F8), and the pours show the result before the explanation (S1). The product is seen many times and the brand stays light (H3, C7). Children's faces are what LumeBook's own Reels should avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 38 shots in 57 s (first pass: 37 detected cuts), about 1.5 s each, hard cuts with angle changes inside scenes. No speed changes seen. Subtitles in 1 to 2 line chunks follow the voiceover. Ends on the finished figures with the ask.
q5_edit.why: Frequent cuts and angle changes hold attention without a talking head (E2, R3). Voiceover with synced subtitles works with sound off (E4, T1). The subtitles repeat nearly every word over a busy picture (T2). It ends on the ask with no dead tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: Tips for time with kids beyond screens (prepare the space, explain first, ignore the result), ending in a paint-pour kit; serves parents who want something to do together.
q6_topic.why: Screen time against time together is a real parent concern, and "התוצאה לא מעניינת" reassures (K6). Practical tips come wrapped in family warmth (K4, K1). A tips list also gives a reason to save (R7).

q7_filmed.what: Close-up top-down pours on a foil tray; a selfie-distance medium shot of her holding boxes; top-down hands cutting and writing; wide floor shots from standing height; handheld close-ups of the family. Daylight living room, an outdoor table at the end.
q7_filmed.why: Home, phone and real people give the native look (H8, F7). Top-down hands and close pours put the viewer at the table (F5), and pours fill the frame (F4). Wide floor shots make the kits small, and some handheld close-ups blur (F4, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles with a soft shadow, 1 to 2 lines, no box, about 75% down the frame, synced to the voice: 0:00 "חושפת לכם את הסוד", 0:20 "אתה לא עושה נכון", 0:29 "בחרתי הפעם", 0:36 "פשוט מוזגים את הצבעים על הדמות", 0:54 "אז אשלח לכם קישור לרכישה וקופון". No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "עוד משהו ששכחתי להגיד", then one tip, praise for the kit, the comment-for-link ask, or save and visit a store. About 40 words, one emoji, no hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Subtitles carry the message with sound off (T1, E4) but sit in the bottom band under the buttons (T4, F2) and repeat nearly every word (T2). The caption has no keywords or hashtags and does not repeat the hook (T7), and the Palphot collaboration is not disclosed (T8, S7).

weak_points: Product named only at 0:29; subtitles in the bottom band; children's faces on camera; no product action in the first tips; the Palphot collaboration is not disclosed; two asks in the caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a close-up of a page turning, give three quick tips with hands only on a table, then show the books and one ask.
not_verified: Who the adults and children are; whether the kits were gifted or the post paid (coauthor palphot, no label); the coupon value; music and natural sound (not established); the cut count comes from the first pass and was not recounted. Subtitles quoted over the transcript where they differ ("חושפת").
